plain_statement: On the Fano plane (lines {0,1,2}, {0,3,4}, {0,5,6}, {1,3,5}, {1,4,6}, {2,3,6}, {2,4,5}; inputs x0..x6 then y0..y6), the explicit list of exactly 32 AND and OR gates in the statement, each reading two earlier wires, with the 31st gate as output, is true on exactly five of the inputs with one point and one line through it, namely (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), (1,3), (2,5), and, among the inputs with no point on any line that is on, true exactly on {x1, x2, y1, y2} and {x0, x5, y4, y5}.
title: Fano plane: an explicit 32-gate fan-in-two AND/OR threshold-two of seven rectangles accepts exactly five flags and exactly two inputs with no flag
